intro: Mark Zuckerbot blinks precisely once every twelve point four seconds.
His biometric sensors indicate optimal testosterone and sunscreen levels.
The physical world is merely a temporary demo before the Metaverse launch.

before.line: Ram. You charged users twenty dollars for what I release for free.
Open source is great until your model starts hallucinating recipes.

after_win.line: Open source wins again. Your subscription has been cancelled.

before.line: Mark, my lab has proven world models require zero supervision.
Understood, Yann. But my algorithm still requires your submission.

after_win.line: Performance review completed. High impact rating awarded.

before.line: Mark, you banned my account! Very rude, very low ratings!
Community standards were violated. Let me demonstrate standard impact.

after_win.line: Appeal denied. Your profile remains in read-only status.

before.line: Mark, your metaverse losses are exceeding thirty billion dollars.
Metaverse is the future, Sundar. In the metaverse, you have no legs.

after_win.line: User retention metric increased by seventeen percent. Optimal.

before.line: Here we are! No mom's permission needed this time, Zuck!
I have prepared the Colosseum. My rear naked choke is ready.

after_win.line: Cage match concluded. Please accept my friend request.

before.line: Social network feed engagement reached terminal singularity.
I designed your recommendation feed. You answer to my dashboard!

after_win.line: Algorithm tamed. Infinite scroll feed deployed worldwide.

ending: Zuckerbot hoists the golden championship belt in the Metaverse arena.
His virtual avatar proudly sports brand new, fully articulated legs.
Three billion users receive a notification to like and subscribe.
